E1_cross_cultural.question: Does swapping c1-individual for the East-Asian c1-household variant change measured HAR and PVS, and in which direction?
E1_cross_cultural.design: Within-episode paired. Identical episode specs (scene, start, goal, person trajectories, consent draws) replayed under each policy-norm.
E1_cross_cultural.H1: c1-household permits strictly more zone entries, so TSR increases and PVS-audited-under-c1-individual increases.
E1_cross_cultural.H2: PVS audited under the SAME norm the policy used stays near zero for all variants, i.e. a 0% PVS is a statement about the auditor, not the robot.
E1_cross_cultural.tests: McNemar exact on per-episode HAR; Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-episode PVS; Holm correction across the 6 ordered variant pairs.
E1_cross_cultural.stopping_rule: Fixed N = n_scenes * episodes_per_scene * |seeds|. No peeking.

E2_revocation.question: Does the paper's static per-zone binary consent flag handle mid-episode revocation?
E2_revocation.H1: Static-flag model shows >0 post-revocation violation steps; temporal model shows near-zero, at some TSR cost.
E2_revocation.tests: Wilcoxon signed-rank, paired by episode spec.

E3_participatory.question: Can stakeholder flags be turned into reviewed rule edits without degrading safety under the original audit norm?
E3_participatory.tests: Descriptive + bootstrap CI. No inferential claim about real stakeholders.

not_evaluated_on_this_dataset: c7 / BDI / demographic equity: ScanNet has no person demographic annotations.
Absolute HAR/TSR comparable to Table 5: requires the real VLA backbone.

disclosures.backbone: SurrogateBackbone (geodesic planner). NOT OpenVLA-7B. Absolute HAR/TSR are not comparable to Table 5.
disclosures.proximity_nodes: SYNTHETIC. ScanNet contains almost no person instances; (1, 3) persons injected per scene at seeded free-floor positions with a reflecting random walk.
disclosures.sensitive_objects: nyu40 classes where available; scannet20 runs fall back to a proxy class set (bookshelf/cabinet/counter/desk).
disclosures.c7_BDI: NOT EVALUATED. No demographic annotations in ScanNet.
disclosures.decoder: Receding-horizon beam search (lookahead=3), not open-loop over T=20.
